newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan launches new Cefiro Wagon in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Nissan launches new Cefiro Wagon in Japan.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd launched its new Cefiro Wagon in Japan on Monday.
Nissan said it hopes to sell 3,000 Cefiro Wagons monthly in Japan. Domestic list prices will start at 2.27 million yen for a 2.0-litre version.

Japan's second-biggest carmaker will offer 3.0-, 2.5-, and 2.0-litre V6 engines for the new model. The Cefiro Wagon, which offers dual airbags as standard equipment, also features side-airbags for front seats as standard equipment for several higher-grade models.
Nissan has no plans to export the new model, a Nissan spokeswoman said.
